verses.text: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?

segments.text: Why do the nations rage,
And the peoples meditate a vain thing?

verses.text: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, saying,

segments.text: The kings of the earth set themselves,
And the rulers take counsel together,
Against Jehovah, and against his anointed,
saying

verses.text: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.

segments.text: Let us break their bonds asunder,
And cast away their cords from us.

verses.text: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.

segments.text: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh:
The Lord will have them in derision.

verses.text: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:

segments.text: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath,
And vex them in his sore displeasure:

verses.text: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.

segments.text: Yet I have set my king
Upon my holy hill of Zion.

verses.text: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.

segments.text: I will tell of the decree:
Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son;
This day have I begotten thee.

verses.text: Ask of me, and I will give thee the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

segments.text: Ask of me, and I will give
thee
the nations for thine inheritance,
And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

verses.text: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

segments.text: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron;
Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

verses.text: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

segments.text: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings:
Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

verses.text: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

segments.text: Serve Jehovah with fear,
And rejoice with trembling.

verses.text: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.

segments.text: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way,
For his wrath will soon be kindled.
Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.
